reviews.t: Excellent product. Finding thinning shears that are comfortable in ...
reviews.x: Excellent product. Finding thinning shears that are comfortable in my hand after 30 minutes has been challenging.  I use these shears to groom my Havanese who has such thick hair that when I thin it, I could make another dog out of the amount I remove! (see photos- actual dog & the thinned hair I removed) Since Havanese have hair, not fur, dog grooming products are useless. claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the shears as excellent value for the price, with many noting they perform like more expensive professional shears.
Many users report the shears cut smoothly, sharply, and comfortably, including on thick or dry hair.
Several licensed cosmetologists and professionals say the shears work well and are suitable for professional use.
A few reviewers report problems with cutting performance, such as folding hair instead of cutting or failing to cut consistently.
Some reviewers note the shears look cheap or unlike professional scissors on arrival, though some were pleasantly surprised after trying them.
